# Spicy Lyrics adaptation

This directory contains code adapted from
[Spicy Lyrics](https://github.com/Spikerko/spicy-lyrics), pinned to commit
`99f3c89c2cec1de579363d712774a770b7925f18`.

The original project is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License
version 3. Cloud modifies the animation engine so it can consume Cloud's TTML
data structures and rendering lifecycle.

Adapted for Cloud on June 7, 2026.
